parsed.rationale: Both participating records — `ReviewRequestServiceTests.recordPlaybackStartedIncrementsCount` (line 22) and `ReviewRequestServiceTests.recordSongAddedToLibraryIncrementsCount` (line 54) — carry `is_test: true` in their context flags. Per the decision rules, any cluster where even one record is test-marked must be treated as a test-fixture and left alone. Although the two test methods share a similar shape (Jaccard 0.75), they exercise distinct user-action paths (`recordPlaybackStarted` vs. `recordSongAddedToLibrary`), and collapsing them into a generic helper would obscure the intent of each individual test case and couple unrelated behavioral assertions.
